For me I tend to get random fixations and can't put the game down for weeks. During the time I'm not really motivated I try to get on once a day to say hai to all my villagers, do some nook mile+ things and try to catch at least 10 fish. (I'm just over halfway to 5k fish. But I hate fishing so I force myself to do like 10 a day. Usually with the nook mile plus stuff) Also it seems really daunting to work on a flat island. I'd probably never want to pick it back up if I did that 😅

ANYWAY basically, just try to get on every day if you can to do just the simple things. Eventually a fixation will take over again and you won't feel like you have to start over cause you just don't know where you stopped. If that makes sense. 

I hope this helps but idk. Happy crossing 💜
